item: R773: every source count the user sees counts sources only (collected from, or enabled and qualified); candidates not yet checked are their own figure with one line x12
key_paths: src/catalog/source_standing.py; src/api/database.py; src/analytics/source_country_rollup.py; src/api/insights.py; src/api/diagnostics/bundle.py; src/diagnostics.py; src/static/app-sources.js; src/static/simple/simple.js; src/static/app-home.js; src/static/app-map.js
summary: Row 39 found about 25,000 disabled Wikidata discovery finds counted as country coverage. One shared definition now feeds coverage, the regional floors, the per-country table (live and rollup), the map, stats, simple Today and World, the Home source hovers, the diagnostics bundle and the doctor line. Release note: counts of sources now leave out candidates the app has not checked yet, which are shown as their own figure; in an exported diagnostics bundle, corpus.sources now means the counted sources (the old flat row count is corpus.source_rows). Read-side only: no row rewritten, no rebuild. The discovery gap-finder keeps the flat count (behaviour is Lane F's).
